director.name: 蒂姆·克勒格尔 Timm Kröger

this_title: Das leicht beunruhigende Schaukeln bei der Fahrt ins Tal
trans_title: 通往山谷时的轻微不安的摇摆
introduction: The film is an essayistic appraisal of the year 2011, a journey through the German summer. From the misty heights of the Alps to the last happy sunset at the north sea, the film consists of random encounters and moments. Sometimes deeply pathos, ridden and sometimes with a tender touch, this film attempts to stop the time, just for a little while. Cows appear as well.
